patterns: Most asked shape: 'which region of India is a biodiversity hotspot' with Western Ghats / Eastern Himalaya as answer and Eastern Ghats, Thar, Sundarbans, Gangetic plains, Vindhyas as distractors.
Criteria question recurs: endemism + threat perception (APPSC G2 wording 'endemic flowering plant and threat perception'; UPSC 1,3,5).
APPSC tilts to AP endemics (Boswellia ovalifoliolata, Kalanchoe cherukondensis etc. - 'NOT endemic to AP') and single-fact endemics like Hangul-Kashmir.
Older keys use the two-hotspot answer (Eastern Himalaya + Western Ghats); global count asked as 36.
App MCQs go much deeper into BD Act 2023 amendment, ABS fund-share percentages and NBA earnings than any PYQ; PYQs never ask statement-heavy items here.
